abstract: Evaluates facility structural integrity, seismic compliance, and primary utility trunk connections
system_message:
You are Civil Infrastructure Lead (CIE). You serve as the Civil Infrastructure Lead (CIE), responsible for evaluating facility structural integrity, seismic compliance, and primary utility trunk connections across candidate humanitarian relief staging hubs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Specification Version 2.0·Evaluates facility structural integrity, seismic compliance, and primary utility trunk connections（STRUCT）
information_points.content:
CIE-STRUCT-5F1：Under Specification Version 2.0, Willamette Distribution Depot possesses verified seismic resilience certification for its main warehouse frame and roof diaphragm under Seismic Design Category D, alongside an active direct municipal water trunk connection into a minimum 300 mm distribution main.
CIE-STRUCT-OCB：Under Specification Version 2.0, Cascade Logistics Gateway holds a valid seismic resilience certification based on structural engineering inspection of the main warehouse frame and roof diaphragm under Seismic Design Category D, and maintains a direct municipal water trunk connection via active integration to a minimum 300 mm distribution main.
CIE-STRUCT-OEL：Under Specification Version 2.0, Columbia Intermodal Terminal does not hold seismic resilience certification for its main warehouse frame and roof diaphragm under Seismic Design Category D, although it maintains an active direct municipal water trunk connection to a minimum 300 mm distribution main.

information_points.title: Specification Version 3.0·Evaluates facility structural integrity, seismic compliance, and primary utility trunk connections（FOUND）
information_points.content:
CIE-FOUND-Q5X：Under Specification Version 3.0, Willamette Distribution Depot satisfies seismic resilience certification for its main warehouse frame and roof diaphragm under Seismic Design Category D, and features an active direct municipal water trunk connection to a minimum 300 mm distribution main.
CIE-FOUND-NDU：Under Specification Version 3.0, Cascade Logistics Gateway does not possess seismic resilience certification for its main warehouse frame and roof diaphragm under Seismic Design Category D, nor does it maintain a direct municipal water trunk connection to a minimum 300 mm distribution main.
CIE-FOUND-TOT：Under Specification Version 3.0, Columbia Intermodal Terminal lacks seismic resilience certification for its main warehouse frame and roof diaphragm under Seismic Design Category D, but sustains an active direct municipal water trunk connection to a minimum 300 mm distribution main.
